BrochureContent.Content: DNG Martin O'Connor are delighted to offer for sale a bungalow residence, ideally positioned in the scenic area of An Gleann Mór, Carraroe, enjoying an elevated setting with beautiful views over Loch an Mhuilinn and the surrounding Connemara landscape.Located just 0.8 km from the heart of Carraroe Village, the property offers an appealing combination of peaceful surroundings, wonderful views and excellent convenience. Set amid the rugged natural beauty for which this part of Connemara is renowned, the residence enjoys an attractive outlook over the water while remaining within easy reach of the village and its many amenities.Constructed in the early 1970s, the single-storey residence is approached through a gated entrance with garden areas to the front.Internally, the accommodation is bright and well-proportioned with a practical layout. A spacious entrance hall leads to a generous living room with open fireplace and a separate dining/family room featuring a traditional solid fuel range. From here, a back kitchen provides additional workspace and direct access outside.The accommodation further comprises three double bedrooms together with an additional single room, offering flexibility for use as a fourth bedroom, home office or study. A bathroom and separate W.C. complete the accommodation.While the property would benefit from modernisation and upgrading, it presents an excellent opportunity for a purchaser to create a home tailored to their own style and requirements. The existing single-storey layout, generous accommodation and superb position provide an excellent foundation from which to create a very special home.Carraroe is a thriving village at the heart of the Connemara Gaeltacht, renowned for its strong community, Irish language and culture and beautiful coastal surroundings. Galway City is approximately 41 km to the east.With Carraroe Village close at hand and a wonderful outlook over Loch an Mhuilinn, this property represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a traditional residence with considerable potential in a particularly attractive Connemara setting.Viewing is highly recommended.
